name: Astrologaster
source:
London, 1592. A great plague sweeps through the capital. 

When doctors flee the city in fear, a hero rises. His name is Simon Forman, “Doctor” of Astrology, Astronomy and Physick. Not only does he have the power to cure the sick, he can find their lost pets and predict their futures! All by reading the movements of the stars. 

But when the plague ends, Forman’s problems begin. The real doctors return to London and they will stop at nothing to bring him down...
translation:
1592年，伦敦。一场大瘟疫席卷了首都。

当医生们因恐惧而逃离这座城市时，一位英雄崛起了。他的名字叫西蒙·福尔曼，占星学、天文学和物理学的“博士”。他不仅有能力治愈病人，还能找到他们丢失的宠物并预测他们的未来！这一切都是通过阅读星星的运动来实现的。

但当瘟疫结束时，福尔曼的问题就开始了。真正的医生回到伦敦，他们会不惜一切代价把他打倒……
